# Stockfish snapshots

Pre-recorded engine output, used by `SnapshotEngine` so the unit-test
suite runs without a real Stockfish binary.

Layout:

```text
tests/fixtures/stockfish/
└── <engine-sha256>/
    └── <pgn-sha256>/
        ├── 0.json    # position at ply 0
        ├── 1.json    # position at ply 1
        └── ...
```

Each `<ply>.json` shape (mirrors US1 production output, T048):

```json
{
  "ply": 0,
  "fen": "...",
  "side_to_move": "white",
  "eval_cp": 12,
  "mate_in": null,
  "top_moves": [
    {"san": "e4", "uci": "e2e4", "eval_cp": 12, "pv": ["e4", "e5"], "rank": 1},
    ...
  ]
}
```

Snapshots are generated by a deferred follow-up task (recorded
against the bundled Stockfish 16 binary). Until that task runs, this
directory is empty and the snapshot engine raises FileNotFoundError
on any analyse() call.
